blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Senator-Judge Raffy Tulfo on Tuesday urged the defense team of Vice President Sara Duterte to present her and the person who prepared her Statements of Assets, Liabilities, and Net Worth (SALN) as witnesses in her impeachment trial. On the 41st day of Duterte’s trial, Tulfo asked defense lead counsel Sheila Sison whether they had intentions of calling the persons behind Duterte’s SALN to explain what he described as discrepancies in the declarations and the properties being discussed during the proceedings. “Pabor ito kay VP Sara e kapag pinresent niyo yung nagprepare ng kanyang SALN, kasi nagkakaroon ng discrepancies […]...
